headline: Brazil's Omni Secures Venture Funding to Expand Medication Insurance
summary: Omni closed a funding round led by ACNext to expand its medication insurance base twofold by the end of next year and reach R$ 50 million in revenue. The insurance product is already utilized by companies including Azul and MetLife.
why: Venture capital funding provides early-stage and growing companies with capital to scale operations, expand product offerings, and accelerate revenue growth.

impacts.name: Omni
impacts.why: Omni raised capital to fund its business expansion.
